source: Accepted immutable Git tree and LFS pointer metadata from comparisons/wma-r1-wave5-structmem-llmlingua-metadata-audit.v1.json

models.purpose: StructMem official LLMLingua-2 precompression and topic segmentation model
models.load_policy: Load only from the immutable local snapshot with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 and trust_remote_code=false. Default lifecycle device is CPU until a separate resource gate changes it.

download_policy.scheduler_gate: Do not download until the Wave1 controller is terminal, all Wave1 model services have stopped, and an independent process audit reports no references to the new target.
download_policy.transport: Download directly on the server into the exact project-owned path; if transferred from the Mac use resumable sftp limited to 4096 Kbit/s.
download_policy.post_download: Require exact revision selected paths per-file bytes and SHA-256 for all seven files before import.
download_policy.offline_execution: All later imports and runs deny network model resolution.
download_policy.cleanup: The project-owned snapshot is eligible for deletion only under comparisons/model-retention-policy.v2.json after accepted numerical evidence and archive verification.

evidence_role: immutable model acquisition design only; no downloaded model bytes, import success, lifecycle result, numerical result, superiority, or SOTA claim
